description:
No spec subject (candidates: the append_only and verifier subjects when picked up). Reported from voyd_config epic voyd_con-xhn (.17), 2026-08-05.

DEFECT 1 — self-authorization detection gap (append_only.ex:569-589). self_authorizing_adrs/2 flags a same-PR ADR only when MapSet.equal?(MapSet.new(affects), removed_ids) — removed_ids being DELETED REQUIREMENT ids. A PR that authorizes a scenario-count regression, modal downgrade (must->may), or polarity removal deletes zero requirements, so removed_ids is empty and the check structurally cannot fire; detect_scenario_regression then suppresses on the authorized branch with no visibility marker. Observed live in voyd_config: the scenario-covers-dedup ADR authorized a scenario regression in its own PR; green gate, no marker; mitigated only by a hand-written acceptance note. Fix directions: (a) extend self_authorizing_adrs to also match affects against subjects with scenario/modal/polarity regressions in the same PR (care: subject-level matching is looser than requirement-id equality — must not over-fire on legitimate cross-PR authorizations); (b) make detect_scenario_regression emit an info-level marker even when authorized, so self-approved weakening is always visible in output.

DEFECT 2 — mix spec.check --debug crashes with BadBooleanError at verifier.ex:1327 whenever a tagged_tests verification has execute: true and runs (a command_result map reaches the left side of 'and'; underlying test exit_code was 0). --debug is unusable on executed runs. Found during voyd_con-xhn.8 verification.

Consumers waiting on the fix: voyd_config, builder, atlas (pick up via dep bump).
title: same_pr_self_authorization cannot fire for scenario/modal/polarity regressions; --debug crashes on executed tagged_tests
